profile.headline: Risk Manager / Portfolio Manager / Trader

positions.title: Risk Manager /  Software Developer
positions.description:
Managed market risk and finances for top tier options market making firm as we ascended the ranks from a small trading firm to one of the largest market makers on CME, trading 20% of the Treasury options flow on CBOT and about 10% of the SOFR (Eurodollar) options flow.
Designed, coded, tested and implemented applications, in Python and C++, that provided real-time analysis of economic numbers and US Treasury auctions, and generated low-latency evaluation of economic releases for trading applications.  Enabled firm to engage in futures and options markets within a second of economic releases.  Applied quick analysis to adaptive decay schedule and other ATS parameters for major economic releases, increasing the profitability of trades immediately following economic releases and US Treasury auctions
Designed, coded and implemented applications that analyzed large data sets efficiently and accurately, primarily in Python, to generate complex risk analysis in Treasury, SOFR, S&P index, Natural Gas and Crude Oil options and futures markets from both internally populated SQL (and MongoDB) tables with precise market data, along with 3rd party data, which was combined to generate a comprehensive view of risk in each asset class.
Managed dynamic risk for 9 individual derivative trading groups, each with unique financial products (equity and futures options, SOFR / Eurodollar options, US, European and Australian Treasury options, Natural Gas options, WTI and BRN crude oil options and futures, Bitcoin cash and futures, US and international stocks, FX futures and options, agriculture futures and options, equity index options), distinctive strategies, exclusive trade time horizons (seconds to months) and diverse market entry methods (from HFT, quote streaming in options to brokered trades) in stocks, futures and options on domestic exchanges in addition to  foreign exchanges in China, Europe, Australia, Japan, South Korea

positions.title: Equity Options Portfolio Manager
positions.description:
•	Created and launched automated volatility arbitrage and event-driven equity and index options portfolio utilizing complex mathematical software engineering acquired thru extensive proprietary trading development, derivative modeling and execution experience
•	Conceived and managed software development projects to generate automated risk neutral portfolio by opportunistically trading equity and index options hedged by options and stock
•	Risk-managed portfolio and initiated additional risk management software development that was utilized by partners and CFO that provided more sensible and practical assessment of capital-at-risk in firm portfolio, individual trader portfolio and stock specific positions
•	Refined expertise in successful automated option execution and  strategy development with one of most successful option high-frequency trading firms, becoming dependable contributing trader and enhancing suite of more than 60 trading applications that actively execute trades based on sophisticated mathematical modeling, precise market data, low latency, rigid trading scenario circumstance logic and parameterization
•	Designed and coded applications using stat arb and modeling for multifaceted portfolio management, then implemented dynamic risk management software that accurately adjusts to changing market conditions in real time

positions.title: Equity Options Portfolio Manager
positions.description:
•	Profitably traded and risk managed an equity option, index option and stock portfolio for the Volatility Arbitrage strategy of a one-billion-dollar (1 billion AUM) hedge fund (average $10mm haircut)
•	Primary role is trading on idea generation for adding theoretical edge based on complex volatility arbitrage strategies using all listed options including leaps
•	Programmed and developed a sophisticated risk management application to effectively manage risk in portfolio to minimize exposure on both long and short side
•	Created sophisticated and flexible idea generation tools using proprietary software in addition to Visual Basic in Microsoft Excel that utilize live option volatility and pricing links to quickly modify search parameters in dynamic market conditions
•	Developed and integrated new portfolio hedging strategies to reduce slippage costs through hedging and created execution algorithms that would be most effective in reducing costs in our trading horizon
•	Lead software development group to design and create a new “next generation” tool that would incorporate and utilize all available data sources and create a series of outputs generated by each individual trader to suit their needs.  Oversaw the development of software and lead a team of developers in creating a cost-effective solution to a gap in risk management and execution software

positions.title: Portfolio Manager
positions.description: Equity and Index Options Portfolio Manager / Trader

positions.title: Owner/Founder
positions.description:
•	Founded/created low cost electronic option and futures brokerage to satisfy void in energy derivatives brokerage market for more affordable alternative to high cost, wide market execution that was generally transacted on NYMEX floor
•	Generated client base using expertise in derivatives, trading and hedging necessities for institutional, hedge fund and professional traders along with persistent work ethic
•	Managed and employed brokers to conduct daily operations, maintain quality relationships and provide accurate and professional execution to clients
•	Successfully brokered and traded options, futures and swaps in crude oil, natural gas and gasoline derivatives

positions.title: Derivatives Trader
positions.description:
Stock Index and Interest Rate Futures Scalper / Interest Rate Futures Spreader / 
                  Execution Software Developer
•	Refined electronic trading execution in interest rate futures markets with increased market saturation by developing execution strategies that react to price fluctuations automatically
•	Profitably developed and traded inter-market scalping and spread trading strategies that reduced outright price risk by offsetting deltas in highly correlated interest rate futures and capitalizing on changing spread prices
•	Coordinated development of automated “black-box” algorithmic trading system with software engineers for use in basket trading of equities vs. index futures
•	Developed interest-rate futures yield curve trading strategy that exploits changes in yields throughout curve through statistical arbitrage

positions.title: Energy Derivatives Trader (OIL, NAT GAS, GAS)
positions.description:
•	Successfully developed scalping trading strategy in both energy (oil, natural gas and gas) futures and interest rate related futures while minimizing risk and losses
•	Assisted in training of trader-trainees by teaching trading strategies while analyzing probability and technical characteristics of markets
•	Evaluated emerging markets and opportunities in new or maturing markets in order to develop trading strategies and maintain knowledge in markets that may render “edge” 
•	Instituted a disciplined approach to scalping and spreading futures while eliminating risk by capitalizing on correlated trades

positions.title: Equity Options Market Maker Clerk/Trader
positions.description:
•	Authored and constructed desk trading software and designed new risk management software for upstairs trading desk which netted over $11 million in profits in 2001
•	Communicated development requirements and end-user functionality needs to software engineers 
            For fabrication of new trading applications 
•	Reorganized trading desk and implemented structural improvements to facilitate more     
      profitable trading
•	Trained fully as equity options market-maker with CBOE certification
•	Traded and hedged equity options and stock portfolio with liquidity value of over $75 million
